csr.heroTitle: Direct Corporate CSR Funding for Verified Ground-Level Civic Problems
csr.heroDesc: SETU connects industries directly with societal challenges requiring financial and technological assistance. Review ground-level citizen demand, university research findings, and fund verified solutions transparently.
csr.pillarsTitle: How CSR Participation Works on SETU
csr.p1Desc: Browse real-time civic issues across 45 categories in drinking water, schools, healthcare, roads, and sanitation.
csr.p2Desc: Review severity levels, citizen vote counts, government verification, and proposed university research solutions.
csr.p3Desc: Provide targeted financial grants directly to problems aligning with your corporate CSR vision and budget.
csr.p4Desc: Monitor execution progress, financial disbursement audit logs, and post-project societal impact reports.
csr.urgentProblemsTitle: High-Priority Urgent Problems Ready for CSR Funding
csr.urgentProblemsSub: Urgent civic requirements verified by local municipal bodies and backed by citizen votes.
csr.catalogTitle: Current Problems Eligible for CSR & Industry Funding
csr.catalogSub: Discover ground-level civic challenges reported by citizens, verified by government bodies, and researched by university engineering teams.
csr.searchPlaceholder: Search problems by title, location (e.g. Kangeyam, Tiruppur, Madurai), category...
csr.directCivicNeedDesc: This civic issue is a direct infrastructure or municipal equipment requirement (such as streetlighting repair, road culvert rebuild, or solar electrification) that does not require prior university academic research.
csr.directFundingNote: Direct CSR funding can be provided immediately for municipal procurement & execution.
csr.paymentPlaceholderDesc: In production, clicking this will securely open the Razorpay / Banking Payment Gateway order window for grant disbursement.
csr.relevantProblemsSection: Relevant Problems Matched to Your Focus
csr.proofSectionSub: Generate and download official CSR contribution statements for custom date intervals.
csr.pastFundingSub: Historical ledger of corporate grants provided to verified civic problems and university solutions.
